description: This Java class 'SurveyEvents' handles survey response creation and parameter restoration within the OFBiz framework. It defines a static method to process HTTP requests, create survey responses via services, and manage request attributes.

classes.name: SurveyEvents
classes.description: A class providing utility methods for survey event handling, particularly for creating survey responses and restoring request parameters.

methods.name: createSurveyResponseAndRestoreParameters
methods.description: Handles creating a survey response from the HTTP request and restoring original parameters if necessary. Calls the 'createSurveyResponse' service and manages potential errors.
